page.overview:
Who is Tyg Rolsum?

Tyg Rolsum prevented a fight between Anton Tolliver and Maxim Kazmir in The Anvil Tradepost, reminding them of the laws of Kanly. He was then approached by the Prisoner told them the he was in charge of the tradepost and the skills they would need to learn to survive on Arrakis.
